title: Depth series: layer count L swept at fixed width, vocabulary, and compute
purpose: Test the a-priori depth heuristic 'one to two layers per attribute the mapping must read' (A = 3 attributes: colour, emotion, intensity -> L in 3..6, paper used 6..12). Only n_layer varies; d_model, d_ff, heads, vocab, tokenizer, pretraining steps, SFT recipe, seeds and the evaluation split are frozen to the W series.

preregistered_predictions.status: FROZEN at first launch: sha256 recorded in backend/reports/scale_grid_depth/depth_series.inputs.sha256
preregistered_predictions.P-D1: Exact tuple match rises from D2 to D4 and from D4 to D6 (both adopted), i.e. at least ~A = 3 layers are needed before the curve flattens.
preregistered_predictions.P-D2: No adjacent step above D8 (D8->D12, D12->D16) is adopted as a positive gain on exact or coarse; depth beyond ~2 layers per attribute does not help at fixed compute.
preregistered_predictions.P-D3: D8 reproduces W384 (same configuration, same data, same seeds) within seed noise: |Δ| < 3 pp on exact tuple match. Reproducibility check, not a result.
preregistered_predictions.decision_rule: Per-seed exact McNemar on the 2,000 paired test rows for adjacent depths, signed z combined by Stouffer, Holm over 5 steps x 3 metrics; adopt only if Holm p < 0.05 and all three seeds share the sign.

notes: Shallow models (D2, D4) have the embedding term dominating (72% / 57%); block parameters are 3.5M and 7.1M.
Pretraining steps are fixed at 2,400 regardless of depth (compute-matched by steps, as in the W series).
D8 is a fresh replicate of W384, not a copy of its checkpoints; it measures run-to-run noise at identical settings.
